title: ServerlessPythonRequirementsPlugin
description: Schema for the serverless-python-requirements plugin (https://github.com/serverless/serverless-python-requirements). Bundles dependencies from requirements.txt / Pipfile / pyproject.toml. NOTE: this plugin's functionality is integrated into Serverless Framework v4.22.0+; the standalone plugin is deprecated as of October 2025. Goes under `custom.pythonRequirements`.

dockerizePip.description: Use Docker (via the lambci/docker-lambda image) to compile non-pure-Python modules or fetch manylinux wheels on non-Linux systems. Pass `non-linux` to only enable on non-Linux.

dockerImage.description: Docker image (with tag) to use instead of the default AWS build image. Mutually exclusive with `dockerFile`.

dockerFile.description: Path to a custom Dockerfile in (or under) the working directory. Mutually exclusive with `dockerImage`.

dockerSsh.description: Mount `$HOME/.ssh/id_rsa` and `$HOME/.ssh/known_hosts` into the build container to install from private git repos.

dockerPrivateKey.description: Absolute path to an SSH private key. Overrides the default `$HOME/.ssh/id_rsa`.

dockerEnv.description: Environment variables to pass to the Docker build container.

dockerExtraFiles.description: Additional OS files to copy out of the Docker build (e.g. shared libraries).

pythonBin.description: Python executable used for packaging. Default `python`.

requirePoetryLockFile.description: Require `poetry.lock` to be present and up to date.

poetryOnlyGroups.description: Poetry dependency groups to export exclusively.

useStaticCache.description: Reuse the compiled output between builds when requirements haven't changed.

cacheLocation.description: Override cache directory path (otherwise auto-detected per OS/user).

staticCacheMaxVersions.description: Maximum cached versions to retain (0 disables the cap).

zip.description: Zip the bundled dependencies. Helps stay under Lambda code size limits.

slim.description: Strip tests, caches and `.pyc` files from packages.

slimPatterns.description: Extra glob patterns to remove when `slim` is enabled.

slimPatternsAppendDefaults.description: Append `slimPatterns` to the defaults instead of replacing them.

noDeploy.description: Packages to exclude from deployment (typically large runtime-provided libraries).

vendor.description: Path to a directory of vendored libraries to include.

layer.description: Publish dependencies as a Lambda Layer instead of bundling them inline.
